coverage.summary: Rental housing providers in Berkeley, as to current and prospective tenants. Owner-occupied 1-3 unit properties where an owner of record lives in one unit as their primary residence are exempt, as are the other listed exemptions.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exempt if the property has 1-3 units and an owner of record resides in one unit as their primary residence.

The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
